title: Reset your password
body: Enter your username. If an account with that name exists, a six-digit code goes to the email address on it.
privacy_note: The screen says the same thing whether or not the account exists. Telling you would tell anyone else who asked.
limit_title: This account has asked for a code five times
limit_body: Codes stop being sent for fifteen minutes. The codes already sent still work until they expire.
no_mail_body: No mail server is configured, so there is nowhere to send a code. An administrator resets the password on the machine itself:
no_mail_hint: The command prints a new password once. It is not stored and cannot be shown again.
no_mail_settings: Configure a mail server in Settings
offline_title: This browser cannot reach your Tel-Agent server
offline_body: No response from {host}. Your calls are unaffected if the machine is still running — this is a network problem between you and it. Check that you are on the business network or connected to the VPN.
